description: Réseau combiné de traçage des eaux de surface et des égouts is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Katholieke Universiteit Leuven. This dataset combines surface water and sewer data to create a node-edge network suited to be used by the BEGOOD tracing engine. Where missing, connections between surface waters and sewer networks are added automatically based on location criteria. Coverage: Katholieke Universiteit Leuven. The portal shows the English title as "Combined surface water and sewer tracing network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Katholieke Universiteit Leuven. Its keywords include network, sewer, surface waters, waste water, TRACING, GO-PEG. The listing shows 6 download or service links in GPKG. The listing shows 2023-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
